findings.finding: GLAS has an effective, refreshed $100m at-the-market program (F-10EF and prospectus supplement 2026-07-15) and drew it in both Q1 and Q2 2026 (2.47m shares, $27.2m proceeds in H1) while holding $18.6m cash against a $15m at-all-times liquidity covenant, so it can sell stock into any 2026-10-02 bounce.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM sells daily without a new filing; the registration is effective and the issuer has used it in each of the last two quarters, so supply can hit 2026-10-02's tape with no announcement. It is the only identifiable flow that can land inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dated ATM-draw reaction is observable; ATM sales are only disclosed in the quarterly 6-K. Own comparable falls: 61 events, median next close 0.0%, but the two most recent multi-day sector falls (09-24, 09-30) both continued the next session (-4.90%, -7.13%).
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the regulatory delay; it has not taken a seller who sells into strength. If the ATM supply were priced the stock would bounce less than a sector peer without one on any relief day; a liquidity covenant at $15m against $18.6m of June cash gives the issuer a reason to keep raising at lower prices.
findings.independence: StockTitan news log notes the 2026-07-15 refresh of the $100m ATM (https://www.stocktitan.net/overview/GLAS/); the full-text probe in the baseline finds ATM language in 6-Ks dated 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-14.
